stages.title: HR recruitment — CV-to-role screening
stages.oneLiner: Turn each job spec into a signed role-skills profile, then score CVs against it.
stages.agentDoes: Builds a weighted, signed role-skills profile; parses and scores CVs; produces a ranked shortlist with per-candidate reasoning and disparate-impact telemetry.
stages.gatedAction: Article 14 human sign-off enforced — recommends, never rejects a candidate alone; every decision Crypto Passport-signed.
stages.kpis: Time-to-shortlist 20+ days to 3-5; recruiter throughput 3-4x; 100% of decisions human-signed and auditable.
